name: bizplug-recruiting
description: The recruiting & staffing plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book an intro call for employers or candidates. It works from the business's own published profile, covering open roles, process and candidate enquiries, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
